def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps(color):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j]==color and (i,j) not in seen:
                    stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while stack:
                        a,b=stack.pop()
                        if (a,b) in seen: continue
                        seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                        for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==color and (x,y) not in seen:
                                stack.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    block=stray=None
    for c in colors:
        cps=comps(c)
        if any(len(cp)>=4 for cp in cps): block=c
        else: stray=c
    bcomps=comps(block)
    strays=[(i,j) for cp in comps(stray) for i,j in cp]
    n=len(strays)
    sj=(sum(j for _,j in strays))/n
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # two blocks, separated vertically (observed); strip toward other block
    bcomps=sorted(bcomps,key=lambda cp: min(i for i,j in cp))
    (top,bot)=(bcomps[0],bcomps[-1])
    def strip(comp, di):
        rows={i for i,j in comp}; cols=sorted({j for i,j in comp})
        i0=comp[0][0]
        # choose n columns nearest to stray mean column
        cols_sorted=sorted(cols,key=lambda j:abs(j-sj))[:n]
        for j in cols_sorted:
            i=i0+di
            while 0<=i<h and g[i][j]==bg:
                out[i][j]=stray; i+=di
            if 0<=i<h and g[i][j]==stray: out[i][j]=4
    strip(top,1); strip(bot,-1)
    return out
